info.title: atlas-api
info.description: Project Atlas — Offline Intelligence and Data Operations Platform. Navigate the Complexity of Data.

post.description: Account recovery: redeem a one-time token issued by a security/system administrator.

get.description: Minimal user listing so project admins can add members.

post.description: Secure offline account recovery: an administrator issues a one-time, 1-hour token delivered out-of-band.
Preview (confirm=false) shows the manifest and verification; confirm=true performs the restore.
Purge superseded dataset versions past retention and notify owners about expired current versions.

delete.description: Permanently delete a project and all of its data. System administrators who are project admins only.

get.description: Locally computed statistics for the home dashboard (all zeros when empty).

post.description: Dry run over the full file: validation, quality checks and transformed preview. Writes nothing.

get.description: Server-sent events stream of job progress until the job finishes.

patch.description: Reviewers verify (activate) or reject relationships, e.g. model-suggested hypotheses.

get.description: How are two entities connected? Shortest paths with the relationships and source evidence behind every hop.

post.description: Execute on at most 200 rows per input; side-effecting nodes are skipped; nothing is persisted.
Stores model suggestions as *unverified* relationships that reviewers must verify or reject.

Natural-language data exploration in two explicit steps.

1. Without ``execute``: the local model drafts SQL (validated, not run).
2. With ``execute`` and the reviewed ``sql``: the SQL runs in the read-only sandbox and the model
   describes the result rows. The narrative is labelled as model output; the table is the evidence.

get.description: Plain-language explanation of a dataset version's quality issues; optional local-model summary.

post.description: Draft an executive summary from the report's reviewed findings and recorded analyses (never auto-inserted).

get.description: Verification mode: reports the configuration and runtime evidence relevant to offline operation.
Dashboard breakdowns, all computed from the project's current data (empty lists when there is none).

post.description: Create a project and load the SYNTHETIC Northwind Harbor dataset through the normal pipelines.
